summary: Describes how the DES cipher in Cipher Block Chaining mode, with an explicit initialization vector, provides confidentiality inside IPsec's Encapsulating Security Payload. DES is now considered too weak for modern use. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: It describes a way of locking packet contents in a secret code so only the right receiver can read them. The lock it uses is an old one that is now easy to pick.
